title: ToolEval
description: Output of the eval-tool assess+verdict phase: a single tool/repo evaluation written to the tooling-eval EVALS.md catalog. Produced by the researcher agent applying the tooling-eval rubric.

license.description: Exact SPDX id (MIT, Apache-2.0, BUSL-1.1, AGPL-3.0, NOASSERTION, ...). Flag restrictive licenses.

verdict.description: ADOPT=install/vendor; INSPIRE=lift named patterns, don't install; REJECT=neither. Restrictive license forbids ADOPT.

lifecycle.description: ADOPT only: 'ADOPTED YYYY-MM-DD' or 'RETIRED YYYY-MM-DD <reason>'. Else 'n/a'.

overlaps.description: Which existing stack tools it duplicates (codebase-memory-mcp/Octocode/Repomix/context-mode/bd/zk-flow/superpowers/GoalBuddy).

liftable_patterns.description: Named, concrete patterns, each with a target file in our stack. Empty if none.

integration_analysis.description: How it composes with our workflows; artifact-flow and memory-model implications (does it change where artifacts live or whether bd is the right memory?). Evidence-backed, not README hype.

revisit_if.description: Trigger that would change the verdict. Empty string if settled.
